comment: Grandfathered occurrences of upstream APIs that already emit a DeprecationWarning.
Each entry is a ratchet: the guard fails when a rule's observed count EXCEEDS its
budget, so the debt may shrink but never grow. Lower a number after a fix; never raise
one to make a build pass. Evidence for every rule is recorded in
docs/dev/architecture-and-deployment.md and reproduced by running the API suite with

fastapi-orjson-response.why: FastAPI deprecates ORJSONResponse now that Pydantic serializes straight to JSON bytes when a response model or return type is set. apps/api/app/main.py:20,294. Removing it requires every route to declare a response model or return type.

sqlalchemy-noload-loader.why: SQLAlchemy 2.1 deprecates the `noload` loader strategy (returns None for related items). The replacement is `lazy="raise_on_sql"` or `lazy="selectin"`; both change runtime relationship access, so this is a behaviour review, not a mechanical swap. The 25th the comparative models added was `GeneFamilyMember.family`, a back-reference nothing reads; it was removed rather than grandfathered (the member already exposes `family_id`, and `GeneFamily.members` keeps its eager load), so this budget stays where it was.

testcontainers-legacy-postgres-import.why: testcontainers deprecates the `testcontainers.postgres` module in favour of `testcontainers.community.postgres`. apps/api/tests/conftest.py:45. Import path only; no assertion changes.

httpx-per-request-cookies.why: httpx 0.28 and Starlette 1.8 deprecate passing `cookies=` on a single request; the cookie jar must be set on the client instance. apps/api/tests/test_security_round2_auth.py and test_analytics_pixel_ingress.py.

pytest-blanket-deprecation-ignore.why: apps/api/pytest.ini and apps/api/pyproject.toml both blanket-ignore DeprecationWarning and PendingDeprecationWarning, so the suite cannot observe the five upstream deprecations listed above. Narrow this to the specific known warnings before deleting it.
